habitat: Moist and dry deciduous forest, riverine and riparian woodland, bamboo groves, plantations and large tree-lined gardens, often near water; 0–2400 m
description: Medium-sized monarch flycatcher, summer breeding visitor to Kashmir; male with glossy black crested head, blue eye-ring, white or rufous morph and very long ribbon tail streamers; female rufous above with greyish throat and shorter tail; hawks insects with agile sallies under the forest canopy in deciduous and riverine woodland, bamboo and large gardens.
